_source: Ambuja Cements Limited, Annual Report FY2022-23 (15-month period ended 31 Mar 2023). Values in LAKHS (the canonical scale post unit-normalization; PDF source was Crore × 100). All cell mappings hand-verified against the published BS & P&L. Cells where the canonical-vs-source classification is debatable are intentionally omitted so the harness scores only high-confidence assignments.
_notes: The reporting period for FY22-23 was 15 months (Jan 2022 → Mar 2023) due to the Adani takeover transition; this inflates Depreciation, Employee Cost, and Revenue YoY but does NOT affect cell mapping correctness.
F8 Other Equity = published 'Other Equity' (₹23,108.38 Cr) + 'Money received against Share warrants' (₹5,000.03 Cr) — the warrant deposit is part of equity until allotment, so it folds into F8.
F48 Fixed Assets = PPE (₹7,556.47 Cr) + ROU (₹823.95 Cr) + Goodwill (₹19.29 Cr) + Other Intangible Assets (₹220.04 Cr) — combined per template definition.

Lease Liabilities classification (per Ind AS 116 + this template's rules): F18 (current) folds Other Financial Liab + Lease Current; F27 (non-current) folds Other Financial Liab NC + Lease NC; F26 (Others NC) is DTL + Other NCL ONLY.
F18 CY = Other Fin Liab Current ₹929.64 + Lease Current ₹301.98 = ₹1,231.62 Cr.
F26 CY = DTL ₹218.06 + Other NCL ₹37.27 = ₹255.33 Cr (no lease).
F27 CY = Other Fin Liab NC ₹0 + Lease NC ₹599.73 = ₹599.73 Cr.
F73 Tax = Current Tax (₹496.38 Cr) + Deferred Tax (₹5.18 Cr) = ₹501.56 Cr.

F72 (Other expenses less Other Income) is computed LITERALLY = Σ(other_expense rows) − Other Income, NOT as a residual that absorbs Exceptional. For Ambuja CY: (Power & Fuel ₹6,012.91 + Freight ₹4,383.48 + Other Exp ₹2,832.09 − Captive ₹28.03) − Other Income ₹952.27 = ₹13,200.45 − ₹952.27 = ₹12,248.18 Cr.
F75 (Exceptional Items, signed) = ₹−157.27 Cr CY (loss). Per Ind AS exceptional items go below operating profit; surfaced as a separate line so the F72 label stays honest.
